CORRECTIONS REQUIRED
An audit of the extractions against James W. Aageson’s doctoral dissertation (Paul's Use of Scripture, Oxford University, 1983) identifies specific corrections regarding printed page-numbering precision, quotation typography, and the explicit representation of authorial hedging.
Itemized Audit Findings & Corrections
1. Printed Page-Numbering Precision (Check #3)
Finding: In earlier turns, dual page citations were included in parentheses (e.g., Page 70 (p. 85, fn. 69), Page 138–139 (p. 202), Page 179 (p. 303–304)).
Correction: The loaded source is the 1983 Oxford D.Phil thesis manuscript, which has a single, continuous printed page-numbering system running from pages 1 through 285 (ending with the Bibliography on pp. 285–309 / PDF p. 285). Secondary page numbers exceeding 285 were inferred or mapped from published versions rather than observed directly on the thesis pages.
Action: All page references are now strictly restored to the single observed printed page numbers of the thesis:
B001-1 (Gen 15:6): Page 70 (fn. 69); Pages 138–139
B001-2 (Hos 2:23): Page 69 (fn. 19); Page 81; Page 178
B001-3 (Hos 1:10): Page 69 (fn. 19); Pages 178–180
B001-4 (Isa 28:16): Page 69 (fn. 19); Page 86; Pages 116–117; Page 183
B001-5 (Joel 2:32): Pages 125–126; Page 183
B001-6 (Isa 40:13): Page 69 (fn. 19); Page 72; Page 90; Page 108
B001-7 (Isa 11:10): Page 90 (fn. 16); Pages 107–108
B001-8 (Isa 29:14): Pages 91–92; Pages 102–103
B001-9 (Gen 2:24): Pages 70–71; Page 104
B001-10 (Deut 25:4): Page 68 (fn. 15); Page 81 (fn. 63); Page 93; Page 107 (fn. 55); Page 149
B001-11 (Exod 32:6): Page 93 (fn. 21); Page 150
B001-12 (Deut 21:23): Pages 74–75; Page 80; Page 92; Page 280
2. OCR Character Normalization in Direct Quotations (Check #2)
Finding: Raw text extractions from PDF OCR rendered Greek words with ASCII corruptions (e.g., euLaieuoev for ἐπίστευσεν, yomav for ἀγαπᾶν, eXeetv for ἐλεεῖν).
Correction: While preserving exact word-for-word quotation, font-encoding OCR artifacts have been cleaned to reflect the author's intended Greek text:
Corrected Quotation (p. 70, fn. 69): "the words ἐπίστευσεν and Ἀβραάμ have been transposed. The variations in the last two examples do not affect the sense of the texts".
Corrected Quotation (p. 81): "The substitution of καλέσω for ἐρῶ in the citation from Hosea 2:25 LXX, has resulted in a verbal connection in Paul's text between the two Hosea passages".
Corrected Quotation (p. 69, fn. 19): "Paul and LXX-B have forms of ἀγαπᾶν, whereas LXX-A uses forms of ἐλεεῖν".
3. Explicit Representation of Authorial Hedging (Check #4 & #6)
Finding: Aageson carefully distinguishes between established manuscript facts and his own explanatory hypotheses, using qualifications such as "probably came about as a result of", "it is likely that", or "the possibility cannot be ruled out".
Correction: Ensure claim statements explicitly preserve Aageson's probability framing rather than asserting absolute historical certainty:
B001-4 (S01F-E008): Re-framed to reflect that Aageson proposes the insertion of πᾶς in Romans 10:11 as a probable hypothesis resulting from catchword association with Joel 2:32, rather than an established certainty.
B001-12 (S01F-E018): Re-framed to explicitly state Aageson's qualification that it cannot be determined with certainty whether Paul himself initiated the omission of ὑπὸ θεοῦ or inherited a pre-Pauline tradition.
4. Attribution and Scholar Disambiguation (Checks #1, #5, #7)
Check #1 (Direct Support): All 18 extracted evidence claims (S01F-E001 through S01F-E018) trace directly to explicit passages in Chapters III–VIII.
Check #5 (Other Scholars): Verified that E. Earle Ellis's midrashic unit hypothesis (1 Cor 1:18–31) and Leonhard Goppelt's typological framework (1 Cor 10:1–13) remain clearly attributed to those scholars, while presenting Aageson's specific points of agreement or disagreement.
Check #7 (No General Model Knowledge): Confirmed that no outside textual or historical information was introduced into the audit.
Would you like to proceed with generating a final, consolidated dataset incorporating these corrected thesis citations?
